Session date: 7:49 pm on 20 May, 2022
[D12:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! How've you been? Been a busy week since we talked.
[D12:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Just finished something - pretty wild journey!
[D12:3] Nate: Way to go! I just got a new addition to the family, this is Max!
[D12:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying on a couch in a living room
[D12:4] Joanna: Wow, he's adorable! How long have you had him? I can see why you're thrilled!
[D12:5] Nate: Thanks! It's awesome - he's adopted and so full of energy, and he's filling my life with so much joy. He's even keeping my other pets active.
[D12:6] Joanna: Pets sure do make life better! Glad Max is bringing you lots of joy.
[D12:7] Nate: Yep, totally! Pets make us so much happier and never let us down. Have you thought any more of getting one of your own?
[D12:8] Joanna: Unfortunately, allergies make it so I don't really want to get any, and I'm too lazy to research alternative pets for my allergies.
[D12:9] Nate: Aww, that's unfortunate. It's nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, though. How do you find comfort when you don't have any?
[D12:10] Joanna: Writing and creative projects are what get me through tough times. I'm also grateful for my supportive friends.
[D12:11] Nate: Wow, that's awesome! Those both can definitely be therapeutic. It's great to have such positive relationships that make such a great impact.
[D12:12] Joanna: Yeah. It's so nice to have friends who understand and appreciate my work - it's priceless being able to talk about it together and receive feedback. Here's a look at what I've been working on – it's been quite a journey, but I made it!
[D12:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notepad with a dog on it and a pen
[D12:13] Nate: Wow, that looks great Joanna! Is that your third one?
[D12:14] Joanna: Yep! I chose to write about this because it's really personal. It's about loss, identity, and connection. It's a story I've had for ages but just got the guts to write it. It was hard, but I'm so proud of it.
[D12:15] Nate: That sounds impressive. You really do like writing about sadness and loss don't you.
[D12:16] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Yeah I really do. I had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics. But I think meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings. It was scary, but I found that I write best when I'm being true to myself - even if it's hard.
[D12:17] Nate: Well done, Joanna! It takes guts to explore your experiences and feelings. I'm proud of you for staying strong and being true to yourself. Keep it up!
[D12:18] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your support really means a lot. Knowing I've got people like you cheering me on makes this journey way easier.
[D12:19] Nate: No worries, Joanna! Keep going and reach for your dreams. You've got tons of talent and potential!

[D13:1] Nate: Hey Jo! Been ages since we last talked. Here's something cool that happened the other day - I took Max for a walk and ran into this super nice couple who had a dog. It turns out they live close by. We decided to do doggy playdates, which is awesome considering we all need friends for our pets.

[D13:3] Nate: It's like fate. Having a walking buddy forMax will be great. He really likes the other dog too!
[D13:4] Joanna: Awesome! Did you get to know the couple very well? What were they like?
[D13:5] Nate: They actually didn't share a whole lot in common with me besides the love of animals, but I think that was all we needed to share in common to be good friends!
[D13:6] Joanna: That's really cool that you can just go out and meet people like that, keep it up Nate!
[D13:7] Nate: Thanks! I just really enjoy watching our pets play with one another. Its like a dream come true seeing my dog so happy.
[D13:8] Joanna: I can see why having a peaceful presence around could help relieve stress. Having someone or something to come home to for a sense of calm would be helpful for relaxation.
[D13:9] Nate: Yep, Joanna. It's great! Looky here, I got this new pup for you!
[D13:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a stuffed animal laying on a bed
[D13:10] Joanna: Awww! It's so cute! I love the thought Nate!
[D13:11] Nate: Thanks! It's a stuffed animal to remind you of the good vibes.
[D13:12] Joanna: That's so sweet! I'll cherish that little guy with all my heart!
[D13:13] Nate: Yeah! It's like having joy in your pocket. It always makes me grin when I look at it.
[D13:14] Joanna: That's great, Nate! Appreciate the small joys like that cute stuffed animal. It's a nice reminder!
[D13:15] Nate: Agreed, those little things sure do make life better!
[D13:16] Joanna: I'll always remember those moments that bring us happiness and remind us that life is great!
[D13:17] Nate: Sure, Joanna! It's all about finding those little things and cherishing them, otherwise it's easy to get down!
[D13:18] Joanna: Thinking back to the tough times finishing my screenplay made me realize it's those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it.
[D13:19] Nate: Yeah, those little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times. Enjoying the ride is key.

[D13:23] Nate: No worries! You've got this. Keep it up!

[D14:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate. It can feel like a step back sometimes. But I appreciate your kind words and encouragement.

[D14:10] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Winning was a huge confidence boost and shows my hard work paid off. I'm really happy with my progress.
[D14:11] Joanna: I am as well! It's great to hear from you about your tournaments throughout the years!
[D14:12] Nate: Thanks! I has been a while since my first tournament hasn't it? I appreciate your support!
[D14:13] Joanna: Anytime Nate! I'm here for you every step of the way.
